text:
samir: Heads up — customer 'AcmeAnalytics' flagged a huge embeddings bill. Dashboard shows 2.4M units for last week but API logs and raw metrics only show ~1.2M embeddings returned. Looks like the console numbers are inflated, possibly a UI aggregation bug. Filing details below. :eyes:

samir: Repro steps I used (quick):
```
# single batched call
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```
querying internal metric: `sum(rate(embeddings_vectors_total{customer_id="acme"}[1h]))` => ~1.2M vectors over period. UI shows 2.4M 'units' in the same time window.

samir: Observations:
- UI label says 'units' (no longer 'vectors' or 'tokens').
- Billing team expects vector count as unit (not tokens).
- The frontend timeseries appears exactly 2x the backend metric.
- Customer reports invoices match UI (so they're charged on inflated value).

julia: Thanks Samir — can you paste the customer_id and exact window? Also any query you ran for the UI backend (grafana / clickhouse) would help. :thinking_face:

samir: customer_id=acme, window=2026-03-08 to 2026-03-14. Grafana panel query (copied):
```
SELECT sum(vectors) + sum(requests) as units FROM embeddings_usage WHERE customer_id='acme' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-08' AND '2026-03-14';
```
That addition looks suspicious — why would UI add vectors and requests? That would double-count when vectors per request = 1 on average? In this case average vectors per request ~1 so UI ends up summing both.

kevin: Oh no — that's what billing ran into last cycle. We billed based on the UI export that the finance script pulled (CSV). If the UI query is summing both `vectors` and `requests` fields, that would inflate numbers. I need an urgent rollback/patch. Which service owns the panel?

julia: eng-analytics owns the dashboard. Likely someone added a derived column `units = vectors + requests` to try to capture both per-vector and per-request charges for mixed products. That was intended for mixed meter customers but we should not use it for customers billed only on vectors. Panel should respect customer's metering config.

samir: Customer says they never opted into a per-request component. They only use embeddings. They noticed the chart label changed to 'units' after last Friday's console deploy (2026-03-13 22:10 UTC).

ops-bot: [alert] Deploy 2026-03-13T22:10 UTC: console/dashboard v2.12.4 rolled to prod (change: dashboard: add 'units' column).

julia: Confirmed — deploy note mentions new 'units' rollup. I'm rolling back that panel and creating a safe, per-customer meter mapping in the query layer. Patch plan: 1) change dashboard to display `vectors` directly for customers with embeddings-only meter; 2) update export used by finance to pull `billing_vectors` from billing DB; 3) add a unit test to prevent UI from summing metrics unless customer has dual-meter flag.

kevin: Please also tag invoices for AcmeAnalytics and place a hold / credit for the delta while we confirm. I'll open a billing ticket CC'ing the account rep.

samir: I've passed repro steps, sample queries, and screenshots to julia in a support ticket. Also added customer timeline and invoice IDs.

julia: Opening ENG-ANALYTICS issue #AN-1789. Assigning to me and @kevin for billing verification. Tentative hotfix: revert panel to vector-only query and update CSV export to use canonical billing metric. ETA: 2-4 hours for rollback to be visible.

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll notify the customer that we're investigating and to expect a temporary credit if billing is impacted.

samir: Thanks. Followups: please confirm once rollback is live and whether any retroactive credits are issued so I can update the customer. :thumbsup:
